Convergence investigation (bugs 85a1/4572 scope), branch autofix-chunk12-20260603, SHA 15e417d818.

This ticket's symptom (_diff_comments re-emitting every local comment per pass) was found ALREADY FIXED on this branch: outbound_differ._diff_comments normalizes both sides via _normalize_comment_body (ADF->text + RECONCILER_MARKER strip + whitespace strip) and emits only bodies absent from the Jira set; the converged-state diagnostic shows 0 phantom comment mutations. No comment-dedup regression observed.

Investigation focus landed on the assignee field convergence (see 85a1): the residual idempotency churn was an inbound assignee shape asymmetry, fixed in SHA 15e417d818. The bidirectional-suppression-blocks-outbound hypothesis was REFUTED at the differ seam (outbound emits local value on contention; inbound suppressed; next pass 0 mutations).

If you still observe duplicate comments live, it is most likely the pre-existing test_e2e_dedup_pass failure (FakeAcliClient lacks get_comments) - a test-harness gap, not a production dedup defect; tracked separately.
